notes:
Summary: Closed-lost. Primary reasons: Together bid on-prem bundle with deeper discounts + integration lift; procurement freeze in Jan; Head of ML (internal champion) left during final legal review.

Timeline: 
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (Priya) - high interest in replacing legacy embedding service.
- 2025-11-20: Demo (SE: Ethan) - showed Dedicated throughput, 95th perc latency ~120ms on test set. Good signal, CTO liked observability.
- 2025-12-03: POC kickoff - ingest pipeline + embeddings baseline; Redwood hosted run but QuantArc insisted on private deployment for IP.
- 2025-12-11: Security deep-dive (fireflies ff_2025-12-11_18923) - discussed KMS/HSM, audit log retention, data residency. Security team flagged timeline risk: required HSM integration + vendor questionnaire.
- 2026-01-05: Commercial review - Redwood pricing was ~25% higher than Together's on-prem proposal for comparable reserved capacity.
- 2026-01-17: Procurement freeze announced (email thread-f:CA+qyLkM-20260117) — headcount and budget paused for Q1 planning.
- 2026-02-02: Legal review slowed; Head of ML (internal champion) left company. Momentum stalled.
- 2026-02-12: Final call with CFO and infra; customer confirms moving forward with Together for on-prem bundle.

POC notes: 
- Tech: Redwood Dedicated met throughput SLAs under synthetic load, but integration work for customer KMS/HSM and existing vaults estimated 6-8 weeks. Together proposed a managed on-prem appliance + migration services, which reduced perceived risk.
- Cost: Together undercut Redwood on multi-year commitment + offered migration credits. QuantArc sensitive to predictable TCO.
- Security: QuantArc required SOC2 + customer-managed keys; Redwood could deliver but timing and proof artifacts were slower than Together's references.

Customer quotes: 
- CTO: "We need a vendor who can be in our data center with minimal lift and firm price commitments for 24 months."
- Head of procurement: "If we can't show 20%+ savings vs current stack, execs will not approve headcount to support it."

Next steps for Redwood internal: 
- Loss recap sent to GTM and product (drive://decks/quantarclabs_pricing_vs_competitors.pdf).
- Update pricing playbook for on-prem/appliance scenarios; consider migration credits play.
- Flag as re-engage candidate 6-9 months after hiring freeze lifts or if Head of ML returns.
- Ask for reference to Together to understand migration pitch and evidence used.

Stale/Follow-up items: 
- SEC-1982: submitted expanded KMS artifacts, awaiting confirmation before procurement (no longer active).
- INF-7431: POC infra request closed.

Sales notes (shorthand): 
- Champion = left (Head of ML).
- Procurement = freeze Jan -> killed Q1 pipeline.
- Loss reason = competitor on-prem bundle + price + faster security refs.
- Winback path = trigger on hiring budget + new champion or if Together fails to meet SLA in 6mo.
